gates.name: Check design/10-design.md references resolve
gates.detail:
Design references OK - 5 citation(s) checked, all resolve to a real heading.

Initially failed with all 5 citations broken, confirmed pre-existing on main (not introduced by this PR). Root cause: contract.md, design.md, fix.md, reconcile.md and slice.md each cite design/10-design.md Section Record or Section Orient conditionally ("Where this repository's own design/state/ exists...") but Test-DesignReferences.ps1 checked every citation unconditionally. Fixed in this PR: citations on a line matching /design\/state\/`?\s*exists/i are now conditional, and are only required to resolve when design/state/ contains at least one of the five non-work record-kind directories (units, invariants, contracts, decisions, questions) the kit's own contract defines - design/state/work/ alone (this repository's already-installed /track WorkRef mirror) does not count, since it is a separate mechanism unrelated to Record/Orient. This repository has design/state/work/ only, so all 5 citations are now correctly skipped rather than required.
